# CPA shared components

Every component in `src/frontend-ob/src/ui/`, with its states and keyboard model (SPEC §6). Values come from the Traverse tokens only. Each one renders in the gallery, which exists only in a build with `VITE_CPA_COMPONENT_GALLERY=1`, at `/cpm/gallery`.

Rule of use: a page never styles a table, badge, dialog or chart itself. If a component cannot do what a page needs, extend the component.

## 6.1 AppShell

`ui/shell/AppShell.tsx`, with `PlantSelector`, `TimeRangeControl`, `UserMenu`, `ShellNav`.

| Item | Contract |
|---|---|
| Header | 64 px. Text mark and "CPA", plant selector, search, time range with zone, environment indicator, theme switch, user control |
| Sidebar | 220 px, 64 px rail below 1280 px or by choice, drawer below 1024 px |
| Selected item | `surface.selected`, `action.primary` text and icon, 3 px start edge, weight 600, `aria-current="page"` |
| Landmarks | Skip link, one `header`, one `nav`, one `main` |
| Keyboard | Skip link first. Tab through the header. Popovers: Esc closes and focus returns. Drawer: focus trapped, Esc closes, focus returns. Ctrl+K opens the palette |
| Theme switch | Ghost icon button with `aria-pressed`, named "Switch to night mode" or "Switch to day mode" |

## 6.2 ContextHeader

`ContextHeader.tsx`. Breadcrumb, 24 px title in an `h1`, one identity or scope line, page controls, one primary action. There is no purpose sentence. The breadcrumb's CPA link keeps the context.

## 6.3 MetricSummary

`MetricSummary.tsx`. Three to five figures in one strip, in a description list. No nested cards.

| State | Shows |
|---|---|
| Current | Value (tabular, key size), unit, window, change |
| Zero | A real 0, never confused with missing |
| Unavailable | "Unavailable" and the reason. A missing value never becomes a number |
| Stale | The retained value, "Stale", and since when |

`help` takes a Toggletip. `to` takes the drill-down link (project rule: every KPI has one).

## 6.5 DataTable

`DataTable.tsx`, `data-table.css`. Native `table`.

| Item | Contract |
|---|---|
| Header | 12 px uppercase, `text.secondary`, `border.strong` underline, sticky |
| Rows | 44 px, or 40 px with `density="compact"`. Text never shrinks |
| Sort | Heading button, `aria-sort` on the heading. The page holds the data and does the sorting |
| Selection | `surface.selected` and a 3 px start edge, `aria-current="true"` on the row. Not colour alone |
| Keyboard | Scroll region is a tab stop. Rows take focus. Up and Down move, Enter or Space selects |
| Identifiers, values | `mono` for tags. Numbers tabular, `align="end"` |
| Long tables | Own scroll region, `sticky` keeps the identifying column. `footer` takes the Pagination |
| States | Loading, empty, filtered-empty with Reset, error with Retry, inside the table region |

## 6.6 Inspector

`Inspector.tsx`. 320 to 400 px beside the main view at 1280 px and up, using `WithInspector`. Below 1280 px, a drawer with focus trapped, Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger. One primary action at its foot.

## 6.7 Toggletip and help registry

`Toggletip.tsx`, `help/registry.ts`.

- A real button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. ⓘ for a definition, ? for "How to read this view".
- Opens on click, Enter or Space. Hover opens after 300 ms, as an enhancement only.
- Stays while hovered or focused. One open at a time. Esc closes and returns focus. Inside a dialog, Esc closes the tip and not the dialog.
- No portal: the panel stays beside its button, so a dialog's focus trap can reach its link.
- **Registry:** 145 entries, generated by `scripts/redesign/build-help-registry.mjs` from `docs/theme/deep/help-registry-draft.md`. Change the draft and re-run; never edit the JSON. Text is verbatim (RD10). Citations and the Q7 marker are separate fields. A test rebuilds the draft from the fields.

## 6.8 StatusBadge

`StatusBadge.tsx`, `statusTones.ts`.

- Tone, glyph and text, always all three. The glyph is hidden from assistive technology, so the label is what is read.
- `statusTones.ts` holds the CD8 rule for each field. Fields stay separate. An unrecognised value is `unknown`, because a state this code cannot name must never look healthy.
- `caption` names the field, so "Good" beside a diagnosis is not read as a verdict on it.
- `Ne107Badge`: fixed `diag` fills in both themes, code and label always together. Unknown is a StatusBadge, not a fifth category.
- **A confirmed finding is `warning`, pending control engineering (CD8).**

### GateBadge and GateKey

`GateBadge.tsx`. **The only way to show a gate result.** Symbol, word and spoken label come from `gateMark` in `components/Cpm/gateStatus.ts`, the SME-reviewed vocabulary (CHG-052, CHG-064, CHG-098), one symbol per meaning. `GateKey` is the legend, from the same list.

Always pass the gate key: a pass on a diagnostic gate means "symptom not seen" and shows ◯, never ✓.

## Signal colours

`--signal-pv`, `--signal-sp`, `--signal-op`, `--signal-vp` and `--signal-other` in `styles/tones.css` are the only place these colours are set. Charts read them through `chartPalette()`, legends through CSS. Pages name a role, never a series number. `npm run lint:signals` measures them for normal vision and red-green colour blindness.

## 6.9 SegmentedControl and Tabs

`SegmentedControl.tsx`: native buttons, `aria-pressed`, Left and Right move and select. Selected state has weight and an edge as well as colour.

`Tabs.tsx`: `role="tablist"`, `aria-selected`, one tab stop, Left, Right, Home, End. `tabPanelProps` links the panel.

## 6.10 Form controls

`ui/forms/`: `TextInput`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `Accordion` (native `details`), `FilterChip`, `InputChip`, `Pagination`.

All 40 px, 6 px radius, `border.strong`, focus 2 px with a 3 px gap. Invalid shows a message and an icon. Disabled says why, on screen. `FilterChip` uses `aria-pressed` and a check mark, so selection is not colour alone. `Pagination` has four named buttons and one status line, in place of seven tab stops.

## 6.11 Dialog

`Dialog.tsx`. Named by its title, `aria-modal`, described by its description. Focus starts inside and is trapped, including buttons in shadow roots. Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger, the close control is named. Footer actions are right-aligned, primary last.

The existing `Modal` still serves old pages. New pages use this one.

## 6.12 DataState

`DataState.tsx`.

| Kind | Default title | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| `loading` | Skeleton rows with a labelled status | Keeps the context around it |
| `empty` | No records | Reason, and an action if one exists |
| `filtered-empty` | No records match these filters | Reset filters |
| `partial` | Partial data | Keeps the retained panel visible |
| `stale` | Stale | Keeps the retained value, says since when |
| `bad-quality` | Bad quality | Keeps the value, says the quality |
| `unavailable` | Unavailable | Retry |
| `error` | Could not load this data | Retry. **Never empty text**: an error with no message says "The service did not respond." |
| `restricted` | Not available for your role | A way out, if the role can use it |

## 6.13 TechnicalDetails

`TechnicalDetails.tsx`. Native `details`, collapsed by default. Each value has a named Copy button, with the result announced. A browser with no clipboard says the copy failed. Identifiers in monospace.

## 6.14 AssetPicker

`AssetPicker.tsx`. The one loop picker: a WAI-ARIA combobox with a listbox. Searches tag and description. The page passes the loops already narrowed to the header scope. Recent loops come first, labelled, from `cpa-recent-loops`, five at most.

Keyboard: Up and Down move, Enter selects, Esc closes and clears the search.

## 6.15 Buttons

`Button.tsx` wraps `ObcButton`, which stays (RD2).

| Variant | ObcButton variant | Look |
|---|---|---|
| `primary` | raised | `action.primary`. One per region |
| `outline` | normal | `border.strong` |
| `ghost` | flat | `text.secondary` |
| `destructive` | raised | `status.danger.fg`, through variables (proposal in R01) |
| `accent` | normal | `action.primary` border and text |
| link | none | `<button class="ui-link">` or a router link |

Painted 40 px, 6 px radius, through variables (`obc-fit-probe`). A disabled action says why, on screen, through `reason`.

## 6.16 Toast

react-toastify, themed through its variables in the bridge, with a 3 px status edge from `components.css`. **Alarm annunciation is not a toast.**

## 6.4 TrendPanel

`ui/trend/`. Props, states and the keyboard model are in `ui/trend/README.md`. Before a page migrates, see the gaps in UI-037.
